```yaml
      maxTokens: 300

  triggers:
```

```yaml
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Reviews groups and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read

  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Reads groups from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_group_type
    format: transform
    label: Count groups by type
    detail: Tallies groups per groupTypes value.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - Unified
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
        - Distribution
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings
    detail: Generates a short groups report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You analyze Microsoft 365 groups for admin review. Be concise, factual, and
        use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total groups: {{ load_groups.output | size }}. Breakdown: {{ count_by_group_type.output }}.
        Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next actions.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200

      kind: manual
    - id: weekly

      intervalSeconds: 604800

    data:
      total: '{{ load_groups.output | size }}'
```

```yaml
name: Dormant Guest Accounts
description: Reviews guest users and reports those that have been inactive for a specified period.
category: Compliance
icon: account-multiple-outline
version: 0.1.0
minAppVersion: 0.1.0
manifestVersion: 1

triggers:
  - id: manual
    type: manual
    label: Run Dormant Guest Accounts Report

steps:
  - id: load_guest_users
    name: Load guest users
    type: microsoft.graph.users.list
    settings:
      filter: "userType eq 'Guest'"
      select: "id,displayName,userPrincipalName,createdDateTime,lastSignInDateTime"

  - id: filter_dormant
    name: Filter dormant guests
    type: filter
    settings:
      source: "{{ load_guest_users.output }}"
      condition: "{{ item.lastSignInDateTime | default(item.createdDateTime) | date('U') < (now() | date('U') - 7776000) }}"
      # 90 days = 7776000 seconds

  - id: summarize
    name: Summarize findings with the active LLM
    type: llm
    settings:
      model: gpt-4o-mini
      temperature: 0.2
      system: >-
        You review guest users for Microsoft 365 admins. Be concise, factual, and
        conservative. Use only the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total guest users: {{ load_guest_users.output | size }}. Dormant guests
        (no sign-in for 90+ days): {{ filter_dormant.output | size }}. List them
        with ID, display name, UPN, created date, and last sign-in date. End with
        a short recommendation.

  - id: report
    name: Output report
    type: log
    settings:
      message: "{{ summarize.output }}"
```
